axis.note: az=atan2(dx,-dy): 0=front, +=+X side, seam +-pi at back midline

mmPerTargetPx.method: local projection derivative (rows per mm) at the crown through the pinned front camera, divided by the registration scale

priorRules.note: no anatomical vertex groups survive in the exported GLB (rig groups only); PRIOR lines are geometric rules anchored to measured ear extent

residualsPx.note: target-frame distance between requested pixel and the pixel whose ray hit the head (0 = direct hit; >0 = spiral fallback offset)

sanity.anatRef: parabola z(x)=crown-0.048-0.030*(x/0.065)^2 |x|<=0.065, y on skin by front raycast

forehead.detail: TARGET-front arc + TARGET-interp bridge across part band

nape.detail: line y=0.025 across back at ear-lobe level with 4mm centre dip

sideburnA.detail: forward of ear groove, under lobe, behind-ear rise; anchored to measured ear extent

templeA.detail: azimuth sweep from -X departure to -62deg, +12mm temporal peak, bottom at earTop+5mm, skin-snapped
